corrections.detail: The roadmap previously copied flat 8481 nodes into the final summary; the actual committed run is 8505 -> 8484 -> 8505. The run remained within its no-growth budget; only the summary was wrong.
The trusted-transformation mitigation is no longer pending: the merged 703945e CI run passed all three Python versions and Browser safety regressions.
Historical UIV2-16/17 restore-crash notes are not current behavior: the boot-order guard is present and this review's real Compare continuity walk passed 15/15 with six captures.

PR CI run 42458307474 exposed a Python 3.12 fixture-teardown race; the duplicate push run 42458278773 at the same SHA passed all four jobs, but the failure was not waived. preservation_suite.stop_server now retains the process-group id after parent exit, escalates surviving descendants to SIGKILL and waits for group exit, with synchronized graceful and SIGTERM-ignoring grandchild regressions.

PR CI run 42459934879 passed Browser safety but failed all three Python jobs because the preservation helper edit had not been propagated through the UI source manifest, preservation signoff and release gate. Those owner artifacts were regenerated in dependency order; source-manifest, signoff, release-gate and release-review tests then passed, including the historical ancestry check after restoring the shallow clone's history.

Issue #185 chose Option A after the V2 handoff: Harness headline counts now name this view/cache on streaming, replay, pruned, stalled and idle paths. The owning walk covers a cache smaller than the log and a cache retaining server-pruned events, keeps count == cards, and regenerates its captures. This wording-only follow-up changes no backend API, session, workspace or authorization behavior; current evidence is refreshed at the follow-up implementation SHA.

follow_ups.detail: A provider that ends after a tool call without producing text can still reach done with an empty reply. Do not claim that provider-failure case is recovered; give it a dedicated backend/streaming regression story.
follow_ups.evidence: UIV2-20 tracking and app.py final_text/done path

follow_ups.detail: Pipeline copyStageMarkdown and some other non-Chat copy helpers do not all handle clipboard promise rejection with Chat's user-visible parity.
follow_ups.evidence: UIV2-20 tracking and static/index.html copy helpers

follow_ups.detail: MCP Activity is an in-memory twelve-entry view, not durable per-call audit; failed connection tests and sync-note presentation are not represented uniformly.
Approval covers 48 structural comparisons, not pixel identity or every conceivable application state. Raw UIV2-30 PNGs are local review evidence; committed JSON binds their manifests and hashes.

rollback.story: Revert the UIV2-30 PR merge commit. This removes the release contract, importer, README pointers and corrected release notes without deleting sessions, database state, MCP secrets or workspaces.
rollback.runtime: UIV2-30 changes no frontend or backend runtime source. Rolling it back does not roll back UIV2-29 or any earlier approved UI behavior.
rollback.whole_program: Do not git reset or discard user data to roll back the V2 program. Revert individual story merge commits in reverse order with their owning evidence gates and reviewer approval.

next_work: Production release: obtain the independent AS-031 human security signoff and satisfy scripts/security_release_gate.py --enforce plus artifact-signing requirements; this agent cannot sign it.
Runtime follow-up: reproduce and fix the empty post-tool Chat completion with an executed provider-failure stream, then prove no duplicate tool execution or false successful reply.
UX follow-ups: bring non-Chat clipboard rejection handling to parity and decide whether MCP Activity needs durable audit rather than expanding the in-memory label.
Roadmap: UIV2-30 is the final V2 story. Start no UIV2-31 by implication; write a new scoped roadmap for any follow-up work.
